app_strings.agreement.decline_body:
To use the app, you must accept the user agreement.

If you do not agree — please delete the app from your device.

You can always return and accept the agreement.
app_strings.agreement.footer:
May Allah guide us to the straight path.
Amin. 🤲
app_strings.agreement.section1_ayah: Will they not then ponder the Quran?
app_strings.agreement.section1_body: The Quran is the Word of Allah the Most High. Read it thoughtfully, without haste, reflecting on every verse. Do not rush to conclusions or judgments based on what you read — consult reliable tafsirs and the knowledge of recognized scholars. Rushing to understand the Quran without proper knowledge can lead to misguidance.
app_strings.agreement.section1_title: On Reading the Quran and Its Interpretation
app_strings.agreement.section2_ayah: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart — about all those will be questioned.
app_strings.agreement.section2_body:
If you convey to others what you attribute to the Quran or Sunnah — verify its authenticity first. Falsely attributing words to Allah or His Prophet ﷺ that were never said is a grave sin.

Every person bears personal responsibility for their words. On the Day of Judgment, Allah will question everyone for what they said and conveyed. By using this app, you accept full personal responsibility for any information you transmit to others.
app_strings.agreement.section3_body: This application was created so that users can quickly and without ads find prayer times, the qibla direction, and read the Quran, du'as, and adhkar. The app does not collect or use any of your personal data — you don't need to worry about its safety. It is a supplementary tool for worship and does not replace personal consultation with scholars, reliable sources, and mentors. The developer bears no responsibility for conclusions that users draw independently based on the app's content.

settings_strings.dayModeGregorianDesc: The day ends at 00:00: until 23:59 the current date is shown, from 00:00 the next one (was the 1st — becomes the 2nd). Messages about important days arrive from 00:01.
settings_strings.dayModeHijriDesc: The day ends after Maghrib (sunset): before Maghrib the current date is shown, after it the next one (was the 1st — becomes the 2nd). Messages about important days arrive after Maghrib.
